summary: Push C day. Lunch and dinner both lean on fresh protein choices for variety (Berbere roasted chicken at lunch, shrimp plus extra chicken breast at dinner) after several chicken-heavy days; black beans and whole grain pasta round out carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Berbere roasted chicken as the main for variety, black beans and roasted broccoli for carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs and protein 60-90 min before lifting: today's wellness protein smoothie plus turkey.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
